files.prompt_en: Use case: illustration-story. Create a production character sprite for a fantasy exploration adventure game. One apprentice explorer named Ira, standing alone in a relaxed three-quarter front view, full body from hair to boot soles, centered with generous transparent margins. Short dark brown hair tucked behind the ears, alert dark eyes, a composed determined expression, a moss green fitted travel jacket over a cream linen shirt, a small rust-colored neck scarf, practical charcoal trousers and worn brown walking boots. One empty hand rests loosely near the belt and the other empty hand opens slightly in a calm conversational gesture. The figure communicates independent judgment and readiness to explore. Hand-painted illustration with restrained textured brushwork, natural body proportions, clear facial features, softly modeled fabric and leather, soft even light, a crisp readable silhouette. The entire canvas surrounding the single figure is genuinely transparent. Portrait canvas 1024 by 1536.
files.prompt_ja: 用途は物語イラスト。幻想的な探索アドベンチャーゲーム用の人物立ち絵を制作する。弟子の探検家イラが一人、少し斜め正面を向いて自然に立つ。髪から靴底までの全身を中央に置き、周囲に十分な透明の余白を取る。耳にかけた短い焦げ茶の髪、注意深い暗色の瞳、落ち着いた意志のある表情。生成りの麻のシャツに苔緑の旅用上着、小さな赤錆色の首巻き、実用的な濃灰色のズボン、履き込んだ茶の歩行靴。空の片手はベルトの近くで自然に休め、もう一方の空の手は静かに話す仕草で少し開く。自分で判断し探索へ進もうとする姿勢を伝える。抑制の利いた筆の質感を持つ手描きのイラスト、自然な体の比率、明瞭な顔立ち、柔らかく立体を表す布と革、均一で柔らかな光、読み取りやすい輪郭。一人の人物の周囲は完全な透明背景。縦長1024×1536。

files.prompt_en: Use case: illustration-story. Create a production character sprite for a fantasy exploration adventure game. One explorer and mentor named Narl, standing alone in a relaxed three-quarter front view, full body from hair to boot soles, centered with generous transparent margins. Weathered features, short dark hair with grey at the temples, neat stubble, thoughtful attentive eyes, a reserved expression. A muted ochre field coat with simple reinforced elbows over a dark teal waistcoat and linen shirt, a plain leather belt, sturdy brown trousers and scuffed walking boots. Both hands are empty; one hand rests lightly near the waist and the other hangs open at the side. His posture suggests an experienced traveler listening carefully to another person. Hand-painted illustration with restrained textured brushwork, natural body proportions, clear facial features, softly modeled fabric and leather, soft even light, a crisp readable silhouette. The entire canvas surrounding the single figure is genuinely transparent. Portrait canvas 1024 by 1536.
files.prompt_ja: 用途は物語イラスト。幻想的な探索アドベンチャーゲーム用の人物立ち絵を制作する。探検家であり師であるナルが一人、少し斜め正面を向いて自然に立つ。髪から靴底までの全身を中央に置き、周囲に十分な透明の余白を取る。旅の経験を感じる顔立ち、こめかみに灰色の混じる短い暗色の髪、整えた短いひげ、注意深く思案する瞳、控えめな表情。暗い青緑の胴着と麻のシャツに、肘を簡素に補強した落ち着いた黄土色の野外用外套、飾りのない革ベルト、丈夫な茶のズボン、擦れた歩行靴。両手は空で、片手を腰の近くへ軽く添え、もう片方は開いて自然に下ろす。旅慣れた人物が相手の言葉を丁寧に聞く姿勢。抑制の利いた筆の質感を持つ手描きのイラスト、自然な体の比率、明瞭な顔立ち、柔らかく立体を表す布と革、均一で柔らかな光、読み取りやすい輪郭。一人の人物の周囲は完全な透明背景。縦長1024×1536。
